title: Karyo project settings (karyo/config.json)
description: Written by `karyo init` (docs/ADOPT.md "Modes"), committed with the project: how `karyo refresh` and `karyo record` read its Python code. Other keys are kept as they are.

mode.description: auto: automatic mode, every class and public function a node with the static call graph, and `# karyo:` directives (or @karyo.node) refining the nodes of the defs they sit on. directives: only what directives declare.

note.description: What the modes mean, for a reader of the file.
